posts.author: MadSeaper
posts.body:
I have a certain skill that i want party to get in the battle. I'm using this command to do it
actor.equipSkill(id, slot)
The problem is, it works only if skill is equippable (No <Unequippable> tag, skill learned and actor has the skill type). Even tho it says that this will bypass whether or not the actor can equip the skill or not.
I don't want player to equip it by themself and see this skill at all. I would love some help!
Edit: I figured it out. I gave actors a skill time and just make them learn this skill through scripts and then equip it.
